conditionBriefing: Rally suspension recommended. Long frost-damaged sections interrupt the pavement. Stock suspension can get through at a slower pace.

name: Ohio River Crossing
durationMethod: Original geometry-based planning estimate; mission weather and damaged-road sections change actual pace. No measured lap time.
segmentDescription: SR 26, the Covered Bridge Scenic Byway along the Little Muskingum northeast of Marietta. The title denotes the campaign region; this stage does not cross the Ohio River.
conditionBriefing: Rain tires recommended. A winter thaw has soaked the valley road. Leave braking room and ease off through wet corners.

name: Ozark Backroads
durationMethod: Original geometry-based planning estimate; mission weather and damaged-road sections change actual pace. No measured lap time.
segmentDescription: Missouri Highway 19 through the forested ridges around Eminence and the Current River.
conditionBriefing: Rally tires recommended. Exposed dirt dominates this abandoned highway, with loose gravel sections between the wooded bends. Reuse your rally setup and keep the throttle measured.

name: Data Center City
durationMethod: Original geometry-based planning estimate; mission weather and damaged-road sections change actual pace. No measured lap time.
segmentDescription: North Broadway / Riverview Drive / Hall Street industrial riverfront network. Fictional automated data-center compounds, frozen cooling infrastructure and abandoned service yards are authored scenery, not surveyed buildings.
conditionBriefing: A balanced road setup works here. Industrial straights and bends are interrupted by short rubble crossings. Brake before the rubble; a rally build trades asphalt grip for easier crossings.

name: Historic Route 66
durationMethod: Original geometry-based planning estimate; mission weather and damaged-road sections change actual pace. No measured lap time.
segmentDescription: Historic Route 66 around Erick and Texola toward the Texas line; exposed plains and abandoned roadside industry.
conditionBriefing: Tarmac tires recommended. Exposed dry pavement rewards road grip at speed. Cooling and gearing can help a powerful build, but are not entry requirements.

name: Pikes Peak Highway
durationMethod: Original geometry-based planning estimate; mission weather and damaged-road sections change actual pace. No measured lap time.
segmentDescription: Upper Pikes Peak Highway: technical alpine hairpins and high-altitude climbs.
conditionBriefing: Road tires recommended for this mostly dry climb. Use the gearbox through the uphill hairpins, then slow well down for the short snow-covered summit approach. Snow tires sacrifice grip over most of the route.

name: Moki Dugway
durationMethod: Original geometry-based planning estimate; mission weather and damaged-road sections change actual pace. No measured lap time.
segmentDescription: Utah 261 through the gravel Moki Dugway switchbacks and their paved approaches; no repeated ascent or descent.
conditionBriefing: Off-road suspension and rally tires recommended. Long eroded stretches demand suspension travel. A road setup must crawl through the roughest sections.

name: Oak Creek Canyon
durationMethod: Original geometry-based planning estimate; mission weather and damaged-road sections change actual pace. No measured lap time.
segmentDescription: Arizona 89A through the upper Oak Creek Canyon and the Oak Creek Vista switchbacks.
conditionBriefing: A balanced road setup works here. Dry canyon bends alternate with shaded wet stretches left by the thaw. Adjust braking at each surface change; rain tires trade some dry grip for wet confidence.

name: Angeles Crest Highway
durationMethod: Original geometry-based planning estimate; mission weather and damaged-road sections change actual pace. No measured lap time.
segmentDescription: California 2 in the San Gabriel Mountains: sustained sweeping bends, ridge exposure and steep wooded slopes.
conditionBriefing: Tarmac tires and road suspension recommended. Dry technical corners reward a road setup; snow and off-road tires give up substantial asphalt grip.
